rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Odoo Gateway provides comprehensive access to Odoo ERP systems through MCP with two-layer security (YAML restrictions and Odoo ACLs), RBAC, rate limiting, and audit logging. The gateway supports authentication via API key, password, or session, and includes built-in domain plugins for HR, Sales, Project, and Helpdesk modules. All operations are validated against configurable model restrictions and field-level access controls.
